name: I2S

policy._this_is_a_policy: What to assume when the device has said nothing - not a measurement. A record that knows its own real figure wins.
policy._bits_above_hz: Nobody claims a step here and nobody has measured one. Unlike the S/PDIF family, whose subframe width is fixed by the frame format, an I2S link's word width is a wiring and firmware matter, so an absent key would assert more than is known.

note: A board-level bus brought out on a connector, with no agreed pinout between makers. Usually carries the device's full capability. Asserts nothing.
